items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Jack didn't play with us. He played by himself.

ctx.x: I'm just trying to think. I can't seem to get it in my mind if Marshall didn't play somewhere with the band, but I can't just get it in my mind.
What about Jack McVeigh, would he have played around with any of the bands, or --
Jack didn't play with us. He played by himself. You know, he played with -- I don't know what you might call it. He played by himself.
